other_conditions: Must be enrolled in a recognized university in India.

Must have secured at least 60% marks in the last degree or be pursuing B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech (Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/IT/Electronics & Communications), M.Sc. (CS/IT), MCA, or DOEACC ‘B’ level.
Must be in the final year or last semester of the program.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a stipend of ₹10,000 per month and a certificate upon completion.
